title: Aloka, the ’Peace Dog, ’ a receiver of constant veterinary supervision, unique pet food
byline: As Buddhist monks walk across Sri Lanka for peace, a special companion has been quietly winning hearts. Aloka, known as the “Peace Dog,” is walking alongside them, spreading a simple message of kindness and compassion. A rescue dog from India, Aloka, today is under special veterinary care and fed with unique pet food.

title: Uproar as Govt. refuses debate on US$2.5Mn cyber theft
byline: The US $ 2,5 million theft had made the partly leaders’ meeting yesterday stormy with the opposition calling for a debate on the issue, and the ruling party rejecting it.

title: Investigation is Sri Lanka’s, Australia will consider further assistance if asked: HC
byline: In response to a question about the ongoing investigation into the US 2.5 million cyber heist, Australian High Commissioner Matthew Duckworth said it is Sri Lanka’s investigation and Australia would consider any request for further assistance if requested.

title: Former President Maithripala Sirisena arrives at Bribery Commission
byline: Former President Maithripala Sirisena arrived at the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC) today (April 28).

title: Cancer patients battle for treatment
byline: Many cancer patients in Sri Lanka are facing life-threatening delays as broken machines and disrupted services cripple access to timely treatment and diagnosis, forcing them into long waiting lists.

title: 34 schoolchildren injured in bus accident in Bogawantalawa
byline: Thirty-four school students were injured this morning after a bus transporting them from the Ranikadu area to schools in Bogawantalawa town met with an accident.

title: Two prison officials arrested over inmate death at Magazine prison
byline: The Borella Police have arrested two prison officials, including a jailor and a prison guard, in connection with the death of an inmate following a clash at the Colombo Magazine Prison.

title: King to defend ’democratic values’ as US state visit begins
byline: They arrived at Andrews military airbase in Maryland before being greeted at the White House by President Donald Trump and First Lady Melania Trump.

title: Showers after 1 p.m. across island
byline: Showers or thundershowers are expected in most parts of the island after 1.00 p.m. today, according to the latest weather forecast.

title: Hull university to lead Sri Lanka wetlands project
byline: The University of Hull is leading a new project supporting the management of wetlands in Sri Lanka.

title: Suspect charged with attempted assassination of Trump at Washington dinner
byline: A California man has been charged with attempting to assassinate US President Donald Trump in an incident that has sparked a White House security review.

title: Two remand prisoners die after collapse during alleged escape attempt
byline: Two suspects who had been arrested and remanded on drug-related charges have died following a collapse during an incident at Magazine Prison yesterday (27).

title: Sri Lanka’s economic outlook remains weak amid Middle East crisis: Dr. Wijewardena
byline: Sri Lanka’s economy, which has been very badly hit by the Middle East crisis as well other external shocks such as climate change, is not expected to have a very promising future, noted former Central Bank Deputy Governor Dr. W.A. Wijewardena.

title: Tourism success questioned as  Sri Lanka leans on volume over value
byline: ​Sri Lanka’s tourism sector recorded a historic 2.3 million international arrivals in 2025 but the industry analysts are urging a pivot in how success is measured within the island’s economic framework.

title: Apparel sector flags urgent policy window as 1Q exports fall 8%
byline: Sri Lanka’s apparel industry yesterday warned of a narrowing policy window to stabilise the exports, after the shipments fell 8 percent in the first quarter (1Q26), with the rising energy costs, shifting US trade dynamics and looming European market risks threatening to deepen the slowdown, unless immediate action is taken.

title: ’Rebuilding Sri Lanka Fund’ is safe: Deputy Minister
byline: Deputy Minister of Finance and Planning Anil Jayantha said today there is no threat to funds received by the ’’Rebuilding Sri Lanka Fund’’ established to provide relief to communities affected by Cyclone Ditwah.

title: Biker gang hunts down referee in high drama
byline: Schools rugby which according to experts is the next best commercial commodity after the Sri Lanka cricket team was rocked in its very first week of the League championship with another referee assaulted or escaping serious bodily injury by a whisker after Saturday’s match involving DS Senanayake College who suffered an embarrassing defeat at the hands of a promising Sri Sumangala College team.

title: Asanga Seneviratne pulls out a rabbit
byline: In a most shocking election result Asanga Seneviratne was elected as the new president of the National Olympic Committee of Sri Lanka for the 2026–2030 term, winning by a margin of five votes at a closely contested election held at the Olympic House Auditorium on Saturday.

title: Putin pledges support for Iran in talks with Araqchi in Russia, says he wants peace soon
byline: Russian President Vladimir Putin held talks with Iranian Foreign ​Minister Abbas Araqchi in St. Petersburg on Monday and told him ‌he hoped the Iranian people would weather what he described as a ’’difficult period’’ and that peace would soon prevail.

title: BOC confirms Rs. 263 mn erroneously remitted to contractors due to ‘system error’: Namal
byline: Despite the government’s refusal of the allegations of the Road Development Authority (RDA) payments being duplicated, Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna (SLPP) MP Namal Rajapaksa said a Bank of Ceylon ‘Recall of Funds’ notice confirms that Rs. 263 million was erroneously remitted to contractors due to a ‘system error.’

title: President meets Inland Revenue officials; discusses boosting Department capabilities
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake and officials of the Department of Inland Revenue have held discussions on programmes aimed at enhancing the capacity of the Inland Revenue Department, including broadening tax revenue, maximising tax compliance and recovering outstanding tax arrears.

title: MP Ramanathan Archchuna remanded
byline: The Mallakam Magistrate’s Court ordered that Member of Parliament Ramanathan  Archchuna be remanded in custody until 29 April.

title: Wildlife office to be established at Mattala airport
byline: An agreement has been signed to establish a Wildlife Office at Mattala Rajapaksa International Airport to address animal-related threats and ensure the safety of airport operations.

title: Daily Mirror raises concern over unauthorized use of exclusive content
byline: The Daily Mirror has expressed regret and concern over the unauthorized use of its exclusive news content by several online and social media-based news platforms.

title: Pirates seize another vessel off Somali coast as threat level increased
byline: Maritime authorities are warning of an increased threat to ships off the coast of Somalia after a cargo ship became the latest vessel to be seized in a suspected act of piracy.

title: Supreme Court judge declines to hear Wilpattu case
byline: Supreme Court Judge A.H.M.D. Nawaz today recused himself from hearing an appeal petition filed by former Minister Rishad Bathiudeen in relation to the Wilpattu judgment.

title: Court of Appeal calls for urgent action on human-elephant conflict
byline: The Court of Appeal today stressed the urgent need to address the escalating human-elephant conflict in the country, highlighting the importance of immediate and effective intervention by relevant authorities.

title: Sajith invites UNP for joint May Day rally
byline: Opposition Leader Sajith Premadasa today officially invited the United National Party (UNP) for a joint May Day rally.

title: European flight prices are falling in short term, Wizz Air boss says
byline: European flight prices are falling as airlines try to overcome customer ’’hesitancy’’ over the economic hit from the US-Israel war with Iran, Wizz Air’s chief executive has said.

title: Tense situation during protest outside Treasury Secretary’s residence
byline: A tense situation arose during a protest outside the residence of Treasury Secretary Harshana Suriyapperuma today.

title: Vietnamese President to address Sri Lankan Parliament on May 8
byline: Vietnamese President and Leader of the Vietnam Communist Party, To Lam is to address the Sri Lankan Parliament on May 8, the office of the Leader of the House said today.

title: AI is like a sharp knife, use properly: Monk warns on misuse
byline: “AI is like a sharp knife,” Vietnamese Buddhist monk Ven. Pagnakara Thera said, cautioning the public about the growing dependence on artificial intelligence (AI).

title: Train collision kills 14, injures dozens near Jakarta
byline: Indonesia’s president ordered an investigation on Tuesday (Apr 28) after a long-distance train smashed into a stationary commuter train overnight, killing 14 people and injuring dozens.

title: Trump not happy with latest Iran proposal to end the war, US official says
byline: U.S. President Donald Trump is unhappy with the latest Iranian proposal ​on resolving the two-month war, a U.S. official said, dampening hopes for a resolution to the conflict that has disrupted energy supplies, ‌fuelled inflation, and killed thousands.

title: Sri Lanka faces looming seed crisis as import reliance hits 92%, Farmers warn amid global uncertainty
byline: Sri Lanka is at risk of a serious seed shortage in the future due to heavy reliance on imports and global political instability Chairman of the National Farmers’ Union Anuradha Tennakoon has warned.

title: Joint opposition lodge complaint on US $ 11 million diesel purchase scam
byline: The Joint opposition yesterday lodged a complaint with the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC) on an alleged US $ 11 million scam in connection with the procurement of diesel through an unsolicited tender.

title: 130,000 Kg of narcotics seized under “Ratama Ekata” to be destroyed
byline: At least 130,000 kilograms of narcotics seized during the ongoing “Ratama Ekata” (A Nation United) operation from October 30, 2025 to date are to be destroyed, police said.

title: Food security is vital to ensuring a nation’s sovereignty and national security – PM
byline: Prime Minister Dr. Harini Amarasuriya has said that, amid the prevailing turbulent global environment, the agriculture sector is facing significant challenges, while food security has become a key factor influencing a country’s stability, sovereignty, and national security.

title: Taylor Swift files trademarks for voice and image amid concern over AI misuse
byline: Taylor Swift has filed applications to trademark her voice and image in a move seemingly designed to protect against AI misuse.

title: Cabinet approves permanent appointments for nearly 9,800 public sector workers
byline: The government has approved a proposal to grant permanent appointments to employees currently serving in public institutions on temporary, casual (daily paid), substitute, contract, and relief basis.

title: Interim housing project approved for Ditwah cyclone-affected families
byline: The Government has approved an interim housing construction project to support families affected by the Ditwah Cyclone who are currently living in safe centres, temporary shelters, and relatives’ houses.

title: ‘Hacker called, forged signatures to steal funds’ – Namal
byline: Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna National Organiser and MP Namal Rajapaksa today alleged that a recent financial fraud involving a government account was carried out through forged documents rather than a genuine cyberattack.

title: Cabinet approves programme to rebuild religious sites damaged by Ditwah
byline: The government has approved a programme to support the reconstruction and rehabilitation of religious sites damaged by the Ditwah Cyclone.

title: Cabinet approves procurement of Adalimumab Syringes
byline: The Cabinet of Ministers has approved the procurement of 6,000 pre-filled syringes of 40mg/0.8ml Adalimumab, used in the treatment of various chronic and autoimmune diseases affecting both adults and children.

title: Dambulla hospital transfer approved for upgrade
byline: The Cabinet of Ministers has approved a proposal to transfer the Dambulla Base Hospital from the Central Provincial Council to the Ministry of Health and Mass Media to facilitate its development and upgrading.

title: UNP turns down SJB invitation to participate in its May Day rally
byline: The United National Party (UNP) has turned down the invitation extended by the Samagi Jana Balawegaya (SJB) to participate in its May Day rally.

title: Gold hits three-week low with US-Iran talks, central bank decisions in focus
byline: Gold fell to a three-week low on Tuesday, as elevated oil prices kept inflation concerns high, while investors awaited key central bank decisions this week to see if the Middle ​East conflict has altered the interest rate outlook.

title: Another USD 600,000 paid to US Post by Sri Lanka Post missing: Nalinda
byline: An investigation has been launched into the disappearance of another USD 600,000 paid to the US Post by Sri Lanka Post, Cabinet Spokesman Minister Nalinda Jayatissa said today.

title: Some media institutions trying to control us: Marikkar
byline: While being critical of certain media institutions, Samagi Jana Balawegaya (SJB) MP S.M. Marikkar said today that some media institutions are trying to control politicians like him.

title: Pakistan, Sri Lanka kick off joint counter-terrorism exercise ’Shake Hands-II’ at Tarbela
byline: Pakistan and Sri Lanka on Monday kicked off a joint counter-terrorism exercise at Tarbela aimed at enhancing professional capabilities and strengthening longstanding military-to-military relations, the military’s media wing said in a statement

title: Trump administration fires all members of US’ National Science Board
byline: United States President Donald Trump’s administration has fired all 22 members of the board that sets the policies of the government-funded national science agency, according to an ex-board member and lawmakers.

title: European flight prices are falling in short term, Wizz Air boss says
byline: European flight prices are falling as airlines try to overcome customer ’’hesitancy’’ over the economic hit from the US-Israel war with Iran, Wizz Air’s chief executive has said.

title: USD 2.5 Mn Treasury funds missing: CID moves court
byline: The Criminal Investigation Department (CID) today presented facts before Colombo Fort Magistrate Isuru Neththikumara over the incident of the disappearance of approximately USD 2.5 million from the Treasury.

title: Ex-motor traffic Deputy Commissioner arrested
byline: A former Deputy Commissioner of the Department of Motor Traffic has been arrested by the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC), officials said.

title: UAE to leave OPEC and OPEC+ oil producer groups
byline: The United Arab Emirates said on Tuesday it was quitting OPEC and OPEC+, dealing a heavy blow to the oil exporting groups and their de ​facto leader, Saudi Arabia, at a time when the Iran war has caused ‌a historic energy shock and unsettled the global economy.

title: “Bring the account holder”: Indian man takes sister’s remains to bank
byline: In a bizarre incident, a man in Odisha made headlines for bringing his dead sister’s skeleton to the bank. The 50-year-old reportedly brought the skeleton as part of his bid to withdraw the money deposited in his sister’s name at the bank.

title: Cable car projects proposed at Sri Pada and key tourist sites
byline: Attention has been drawn to proposals for introducing cable car systems at several key tourist destinations, including Sri Pada (Adam’s Peak), as part of efforts to enhance the country’s tourism infrastructure.

title: President revives centuries-old tradition with Sri Maha Bodhi sapling presentation
byline: President Anura Kumara Dissanayake today ceremonially presented a sapling of the Sri Maha Bodhi to a group of monks led by Venerable Paññākāra Thera at Independence Square.

title: Shammi Silva, SLC Executive Committee decide to resign
byline: Shammi Silva, President of Sri Lanka Cricket, along with the SLC Executive Committee, has decided to step down following a special committee meeting held today.

title: Austrian man admits plot to attack 2024 Taylor Swift concert
byline: A man accused of plotting a terror attack at one of Taylor Swift’s concerts in Vienna in 2024 pleaded guilty on Tuesday.

title: Monks led by Ven. Paññākāra Thera conclude peace walk at Independence Square
byline: A group of monks led by Venerable Paññākāra Thera, who had been walking across major cities including Anuradhapura, Kandy, and Colombo to promote compassion, mindfulness, and unity, reached Independence Square a short while ago.

title: Bangladesh starts fuelling its first nuclear power station
byline: Bangladesh will begin loading uranium fuel into its first nuclear power station on Tuesday (Apr 28), a key step towards bringing the 2,400 megawatt plant online to ease pressure on the overstretched power grid.

title: ’Indian airline industry on verge of stopping operations,’ says FIA; seeks govt intervention
byline: The airline Industry in India is under extreme stress and on the verge of closing down or stopping operations.” This dire warning has been issued by the Federation of Indian Airlines (FIA), which represents Air India, IndiGo and SpiceJet, in an “urgent” SOS sent to the government, seeking the latter’s “urgent intervention” in aviation turbine fuel (ATF) pricing.

title: Treasury Secretary summoned before COPF
byline: Treasury Secretary Harshana Suriyapperuma has been summoned to appear before the Committee on Public Finance (COPF) to provide explanations regarding a cyber theft involving the alleged loss of USD 2.5 million.

title: BIA arrest of monks: President convenes urgent meeting
byline: A high-level discussion was held this afternoon (28) at the Presidential Secretariat under the patronage of President Anura Kumara Dissanayake, focusing on the recent arrest of a group of Buddhist monks at Bandaranaike International Airport (BIA) over the possession of narcotics and the developments that followed.

title: Market edges up on value buying as crossings surge
byline: The Colombo Stock Exchange closed with marginal gains today, as both indices ended in positive territory amid steady market activity. Improved turnover and share volumes signaled a gradual pickup in participation, while increased crossing transactions pointed to renewed interest from value investors.

title: Kusal Mendis - PSL Run-Machine
byline: Kusal Mendis may have had his up and downs in his career, but the right handed wicketkeeper has been in prolific form in the last couple of years. Ever since he moved down the order in Test cricket, the former Prince of Wales College captain has had a decent run of form in all formats.

title: UAE to leave OPEC and OPEC+ oil producer groups
byline: The United Arab Emirates said on Tuesday it was quitting OPEC and OPEC+, dealing a heavy blow to the oil exporting groups and their de ​facto leader, Saudi Arabia, at a time when the Iran war has caused ‌a historic energy shock and unsettled the global economy.

title: Austrian man admits plot to attack 2024 Taylor Swift concert
byline: A man accused of plotting a terror attack at one of Taylor Swift’s concerts in Vienna in 2024 pleaded guilty on Tuesday.
